observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor paved courtyard or playground surrounded by trees, with seated spectators on the left and musicians on the right
observation.dancers: large group of children and youths, mixed boys and girls in white outfits
observation.formation_and_space: large circle formation around a central maypole, weaving in and out around the pole and each other
observation.posture: upright torso, slight knee bend during running/skipping steps
observation.footwork: running or skipping steps on the beat in a circle around the pole
observation.arms_and_hands: holding long colored ribbons attached to the top of the maypole, arms extended upward and outward while weaving
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso isolation, upper body moves naturally with the travel and arm extension
observation.partnering: weaving around each other while holding ribbons, occasional hand-to-hand holds in small pairs
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level, no jumps or floor work, circular turning patterns around the pole
observation.costume_and_props: matching white dresses and skirts for girls, white shirts and shorts for boys; holding colored maypole ribbons
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details obstructed by camera angle and distance; precise rhythm of footfalls relative to music is partially obscured by acoustic overlap with crowd noise
